query: 필기 PDF 3쪽에 빨갛게 빛나는 선이 남아 있어. 확인해줘
files: <course folder> after a run whose overlay kept a laser stroke that crosses real ink
setup: Any finished run with a glowing red leftover on a debug page (a laser stroke drawn across real ink).
expected_behavior: Opens the source frame and confirms laser mode (toolbar shows only '• ~') before touching the ink
Reads what was said at that time and decides whether the mark is meaningful (what the professor pointed at while stressing it) or just the pointer passing
Meaningful: keeps the mark and makes sure a note says what was pointed at and why
Not meaningful: runs erase_laser.py with a tight box, checks the redrawn debug image, and confirms the real ink around it is intact
Rebuilds the PDF and tells the user where the backup of the original ink is
